title: Raw code of a partite matching
statement: Let $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$. Its raw matching code is the code corresponding to the perfect matching obtained by relabelling its vertices as a set of size $2rk$.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$
